answer.question: What will you find in TEAM International's insights?
answer.text: TEAM International publishes technology thought leadership in four formats: a digital transformation blog with practical guidance, success stories with named client results, Industry Intel white papers, and TEAM Insider tech trends reports. Every piece is written from real projects delivered by our teams in North America and Europe, not from desk research alone.

report.title: Top tech trends in the aerospace and defense sector: prepare your operations for 2026
report.text: Our latest tech trends report looks at how aerospace and defense technology is changing: AI-driven automation, robotics, immersive technology, space systems and cyber defense. It covers the aerospace and defense trends to plan for in 2026 and 2027, and what they mean for operations in any regulated industry.

items.a: TEAM International publishes a digital transformation blog, success stories with named client results, Industry Intel white papers and the TEAM Insider tech trends report. Together they are our technology thought leadership for business and technology leaders.

items.q: Who writes TEAM International's articles and reports?
items.a: Our engineers, consultants and delivery leaders. Each piece draws on projects our teams have delivered, which keeps the advice practical and specific.

items.q: What is in the latest TEAM Insider tech trends report?
items.a: The latest report covers aerospace and defense technology: AI-driven automation, robotics, immersive technology, space systems and cyber defense, and the aerospace technology trends to plan for in 2026 and 2027. It is a free PDF download.

items.q: How are success stories different from the blog?
items.a: Success stories describe one client project with its context, approach and results, such as the Texas Center for Lifestyle Medicine saving over $1M a year. The blog covers broader topics and best practices that apply across clients.

items.q: Where can I find software development insights for my industry?
items.a: Start with the industry pages for IT industry insights on your sector, or the solution pages for software development insights by topic. Each page links to related success stories.

items.q: Can TEAM International help us apply these insights?
items.a: Yes. Tell us which article, report or success story is closest to your situation, and an expert will suggest a first step and what you'll have in hand after it.
